notes.content:
Dear street racers,

Consider joining the discord, which brings together the community of Drift86 and Initial Drift Online.

Link to the discord

DLC - Car Pack 2
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3626790/Initial_Drift_Online__Car_Pack_2/



Here is some information about the new features of the game.

- A new map is available : Myogi (DLC) (Reworked map of the Kuroshiba model)
- A new car is available : MAKO (DLC)
- A new car is available : EVA 3 (DLC)
- A new car is available : IKEDAZ (DLC)
- A new car is available : CHASSEUR (DLC)
- The engine can now be turned on or off by pressing the "i" key by default.
- You can now remap all keyboard and gamepad input controls.
- Delivery time is now displayed during delivery.
- Proximity voice chat is now available with the "v" key by default
- You can now invite your steam friend to join your game.
- Performance optimization.
- The camera used is now saved between maps.
- You can now change the metallic and glossy setting of the car paint.
- You can now change the metallic and glossy setting of the car rim paint.
- A button to teleport to the bottom of Irohazaka is now available.
- Fixed Haruna Spawnpoint.
- 3D leaderboards have been fixed.
- Some other bugs were fixed.

Also, the player with the best downhill tofu delivery time on Myogi will win a $100 Steam gift card.

To be eligible, simply upload your run to YouTube (HD) with the game link in the description. Then, send the link to your video to the Initial Drift Online speedrun channel on Discord.

You can also become friends on Steam with the official Rewindapp account (to send the Steam gift card). What an honor! The contest ends on May 1st.

notes.title: Update Infos 3
notes.content:
Dear street racers,

First of all Happy New Year 2021 everyone!

So we are still currently working on ps4 and steering wheel compatibility. A new day / night system has been added (we are in the process of fixing some bugs concerning it) and for those who are wondering, we cannot for the moment put a day / night system 100% dynamic without the players with Low pc configurations have a sharp drop in fps.

Here is some information about the new features of the game.

- A tutorial was added for beginners.
- The tire tracks were added.
- Overall game graphics improvement without significant fps loss.
- A new day / night system has been added.
- Number value for Steering Sensitivity and Steering Helper has been added.
- Uphill delivery in Haruna is now available.
- Downhill delivery in Akagi is now available.
- No reward when the opponent leaves the race fixed (you must complete the race to get the reward)
- Hachiroku tuned collision fixed.
- The braking of cars has been changed.
- The loss of fps when braking has been fixed.
- And a lots of little bugs has been fixed.
